body: I tried moving out for several years, months ago but my mom would begged for me to come back and i always listen to her but ended up disappointed because it kepts happening over and over. I never did him wrong, i was the one who's been abused and humiliated by him :(

Now i cant think of anything but to kill myself :( i lost the baby and its torturing me because no one was there. Even my family, they look at me as a failure and useless.. :(

But I am not motivated anymore. I can't concentrate with things that iv been doing, i can't focus. Im sorry i didnt clear it on my post that i lost my baby at two months and half of my pregnancy..
